title: Ottoman Empire (c. 1299-1922)
key_facts: Longest-lasting Islamic empire spanning three continents
Captured Constantinople in 1453 ending Byzantine Empire
Controlled trade routes between Europe and Asia
Multicultural empire with diverse religious populations
causes: Turkic migration and military organization under Osman I
Decline of Byzantine Empire creating power vacuum
Strategic location between Europe, Asia, and Africa
Military innovation with gunpowder and siege tactics
outcome: Defeated in World War I after siding with Central Powers
Legacy of Islamic architecture and legal systems
impacts: Ended Byzantine Empire and Roman imperial continuity
Controlled key trade routes for centuries
Created lasting cultural and architectural legacy
